QuestInfo.name: Maya's Concerns 1
QuestInfo.0: By the way, how's Maya doing? I better go check her out!
QuestInfo.1:
Maya was attending a baby monster that's been deeply wounded. I know this is not what people would want us to do, but Maya wanted to do it, and I have to help her out. Oh well... in order to fix the wound, she said she needs #b50 #t02050003#s#k, #b20 #t04000086#s#k, and #b20 #t04000023#s#k. 

#t02050003# #b#c02050003##k/50
#t04000086#  #b#c04000086##k/20
#t04000023#  #b#c04000023##k/20
QuestInfo.2: The wound is sanitized, but the baby Lioner should rest.  It seems very tired from the ordeal.

0.0: Thank you so much for your work the other day. Thanks to you, I feel much healthier than ever, and I owe you a whole lot for this. \nActually... I have something to discuss with you today. I haven't found anyone willing to discuss something big like this, so... will you be my friend and listen to my story? I know that you'll keep this a secret.
0.1: Please look.\n (Maya slowly moves around, and looks at the bottom of the bed.)\n (Below is a little kitty, huffing and puffing for breath. It's also badly scarred. This kitty is...)
0.2: It's the baby Lioner. \nSurprised? Yeah, I know... it's a baby and all, but it's a monster nonetheless. I was on my way to dig out some herbs when I found it crawled up in between the rocks. I know it's a monster, but... I couldn't just walk by and ignore it. I know how that feels like...
0.3: This is my plea to you. Please save this poor baby. If the people ever find out I'm nursing this, I may not be able to live here anymore.\nThat's alright, though. Please help.\nYou're the only one I can ask for something like this.

yes.0: Thank you so much. You're such a nice person. Please save these two babies. \nFirst, we'll need to sanitize the wounds, and to do that I'll need a whole lot of #b#t02050003##k.
yes.1: I can't leave these babies by themselves, so can you get me #b50 #t02050003#s#k, #b20 #t04000086#s#k with #b#t02050003##k on, and #b20 #t04000023#s#k to settle the wounds. Thank you.

no.0: Really? I see. I can see how this may be a distraction to you. I do not want to put you in jeopardy. Just forget about it. I'll do what I can here.

1.0: Thank you so much. I'll sanitize the wounds immediately.

yes.0: （After putting #b#t02050003##k on #b#t04000086##k, Maya proceeded to apply this to the wounds where it'd no doubt sting. Baby Lioner screamed in agony.）
yes.1: Oh no, I'm sorry. Please hold on.\nIf I don't sanitize the area, the wounds will be infected... \nYou're a boy, right? Don't cry then.\m (Maya talks to it as if it's a human baby)
yes.2: Okay, the wound is cleaned up. This should make sure the wound doesn't get infected.

item.0: I don't think you have enough to sanitize the wounds. Since the wound is very deep, I'll need #b50 #t02050003#s#k, #b20 #t04000086#s#k, and #b20 #t04000023#s#k.
